name: Arunachal Pradesh overlay (partial)
notes: Partial: central CMVR rules plus researched state overrides (checked 2026-10-25). Verify at your RTO. Transport department: https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/sarathiservice/stateSelection.do

text.en: We could not confirm a home LL test in Arunachal Pradesh, so plan for the test at the RTO. If Sarathi offers the online test for you, you can use it.
text.hi: Arunachal Pradesh में घर से LL टेस्ट की पुष्टि नहीं हो पाई, इसलिए RTO पर टेस्ट की योजना बनाएँ। अगर सारथी पर ऑनलाइन टेस्ट दिखे, तो उसका उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh: learner's licence test mode

text.en: Faceless transport services were announced in Oct 2025; the home LL test is not confirmed yet.
